assessed_by: Author self-assessment, not an independent review (rubric HG8 and R9.4).

scope.environment: machine-level laboratory terminal trap; no privilege modes
scope.configuration: RESET_PC 0; ICACHE_BEATS 512; DCACHE_BEATS 512; up to three instructions per clock (0.5.0 to 0.7.0); retirement trace ports always present
scope.platform: rv64_bram_soc synchronous RAM: reads answer the next clock, writes in the same clock; 64 KiB for benchmarks, 16 KiB for the regression

HG1.evidence: Scope label lacks the performance target (rubric section 2). RTL hashes are recorded.

HG2.evidence: Computed from build/cpu/verification.json: must be PASS on the current RTL hashes.

HG3.evidence: Only the project-written reference model; no official architectural tests or external model.

HG4.evidence: Every implemented cause (0-7, 11) is triggered in sim/cpu/test_cpu.py with exact PC, cause and value; terminal trap record only.

HG5.evidence: No capability CSR; unimplemented encodings (for example funct7 2, mulhw and CSR instructions) are tested to trap.

HG6.evidence: No known-issue list exists to review.

HG7.evidence: Icarus -Wall only; no dedicated lint or synthesis run.

HG8.evidence: No independent reviewer has reproduced the results.

PG1.evidence: Met only when HG1-HG8 are all met.

PG3.evidence: No CoreMark; Dhrystone runs are non-compliant simulation runs.

PG4.evidence: Benchmarks run the same RTL hashes as the regression; no benchmark-only configuration.

R1.1.evidence: All 106 instructions of rv64im_zba_zbb_zbs_zifencei pass local differential tests (E1); B is also cross-checked against compiler-generated base code; no architectural tests or external lockstep (needs E2).

R1.2.evidence: Directed illegal encodings trap (E1); no random-word sweep against an external model.

R1.3.evidence: Extreme constants, shift limits, word sign extension, divide by zero, signed overflow and -1 operands are tested; no written corner table.

R1.4.evidence: Every width, byte lane and sign/zero extension tested; misaligned accesses trap per the declared policy.

R1.5.evidence: x0, alignment and no-side-effect traps are checked through trace comparison, not by assertions in every simulation.

R1.6.evidence: Suite enforces coverage of all 106 instruction names; no per-item ledger mapping RTL to tests for the claimed ISA.

R2.1.evidence: Every implemented cause triggered with correct PC, cause and value; faulting instruction does not retire.

R2.2.na: Laboratory terminal-trap core: no trap return.

R2.3.na: No interrupts in the laboratory environment.

R2.5.evidence: Reset tested during one stalled store only (sim/cpu/tb_reset.sv), not in every control state.

R3.2.evidence: Suite fails on missing instruction names or branch outcomes; trap causes and lanes are covered but not enforced as coverage bins.

R3.4.evidence: 3,000 random instructions: register and immediate arithmetic plus M operations; no random loads, stores or control flow.

R3.7.evidence: Full suite runs in CI on every push; recorded results name the RTL hashes.

R4.1.evidence: Computed from the Dhrystone run's clocks per instruction; capped at 2 while the benchmark set lacks CoreMark.

R4.4.evidence: No achieved frequency, so no absolute throughput.

R4.5.evidence: Per-instruction FETCH, EXECUTE and MEMORY clocks are measured on every Dhrystone run and logged; branches, traps and stalls are not tabulated separately.

R4.6.evidence: Clocks per instruction reported at zero added wait cycles only.

R4.8.evidence: Each Dhrystone run is logged with RTL hashes and compared with the previous run; no automated failure on regression.

R5.5.evidence: No reset synchronizer or crossing report.

R6.1.evidence: Trace testbench fails on any change to a stalled request and on any request after a trap, in every run.

R6.2.evidence: Random waits up to 19 clocks; no stall of 1,000 clocks tested.

R6.3.evidence: Fetch, load and store bus errors each tested; precise trap and no write.

R6.4.evidence: Reads carry no access size; fetch reads a full 8-byte beat; since 0.3.0 all addresses are cached, so a peripheral region would need a PMA marking it uncacheable. Documented limitation.

R6.5.evidence: RAM_WORDS tested at 2048 and 8192; ICACHE_BEATS and DCACHE_BEATS at 2 and 512, with illegal sizes rejected at elaboration; RESET_PC only at its default.

R6.6.evidence: Unmodified clang output runs, including Dhrystone; CoreMark not yet.

R7.1.evidence: Trace has PC, instruction, destination, value and next PC for up to three retirements per clock; no source values, memory fields or trap flags.

R7.2.evidence: Trap cause, PC and value stay stable and visible after any trap.

R7.4.evidence: Trace logic cannot be removed by a parameter.

R8.1.evidence: Icarus -Wall only; no dedicated lint run.

R8.2.evidence: Synthesizable style by inspection; not yet accepted by a synthesis tool.

R8.3.evidence: Architecture document written with the RTL; no item-by-item check recorded.

R8.4.evidence: Retirement boundary is clean, but no long-operation interface exists yet to judge.

R9.1.evidence: Documented commands reproduce the regression and Dhrystone locally and in CI; C demo and lessons not in CI.

R9.2.evidence: Tool versions, flags and hashes recorded; benchmark runner refuses stale builds automatically.

R9.3.evidence: New documents carry scope and evidence class; older C demo documents do not use the evidence classes.
